accept.inner_basic: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
accept.inner_keyword: SELECT * FROM a INNER JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
accept.left_alias: SELECT o.oid, c.name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON o.cid = c.cid
accept.left_outer: SELECT * FROM a LEFT OUTER JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
accept.composite_on: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k1 = b.k1 AND a.k2 = b.k2
accept.reversed_on: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON b.k = a.k
accept.using_single: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b USING (k)
accept.using_composite: SELECT * FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (k1, k2)
accept.quoted_identifiers: SELECT * FROM "my tab" AS "x.y" JOIN "b""q" ON "x.y"."a""b" = "b""q".k
accept.unqualified_keys: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON ka = kb
accept.relation_star: SELECT a.*, b.k FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
accept.column_alias: SELECT a.k AS key FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
accept.self_join: SELECT * FROM t a JOIN t b ON a.k = b.k
accept.trailing_semicolon: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k;
accept.comment:
SELECT * -- all columns
FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k /* key */
accept.three_key_and: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k1 = b.k1 AND (a.k2 = b.k2 AND a.k3 = b.k3)
accept.from_first_syntax: FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k SELECT *

refuse.cast_key: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = CAST(b.k AS BIGINT)
refuse.expression_key: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k + 1 = b.k
refuse.non_equality: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k < b.k
refuse.or_condition: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k OR a.k = 0
refuse.not_distinct: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.k
refuse.constant_condition: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = 1
refuse.collate: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.s = b.s COLLATE NOCASE
refuse.right_join: SELECT * FROM a RIGHT JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.full_join: SELECT * FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.cross_join: SELECT * FROM a CROSS JOIN b
refuse.comma_join: SELECT * FROM a, b WHERE a.k = b.k
refuse.natural_join: SELECT * FROM a NATURAL JOIN b
refuse.asof_join: SELECT * FROM a ASOF JOIN b ON a.k >= b.k
refuse.positional_join: SELECT * FROM a POSITIONAL JOIN b
refuse.semi_join: SELECT * FROM a SEMI JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.anti_join: SELECT * FROM a ANTI JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.where: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k WHERE a.k > 0
refuse.group_by: SELECT a.k, count(*) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k GROUP BY a.k
refuse.having: SELECT a.k FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k GROUP BY a.k HAVING count(*) > 1
refuse.order_by: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k ORDER BY a.k
refuse.limit: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k LIMIT 10
refuse.distinct: SELECT DISTINCT a.k FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.qualify: SELECT a.k FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k QUALIFY row_number() OVER () = 1
refuse.using_sample: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k USING SAMPLE 10
refuse.tablesample: SELECT * FROM a TABLESAMPLE 10% JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.cte: WITH c AS (SELECT * FROM b) SELECT * FROM a JOIN c ON a.k = c.k

refuse.subquery_where: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k WHERE a.k IN (SELECT k FROM c)
refuse.subquery_select: SELECT (SELECT 1) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.union: SELECT a.k FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k UNION ALL SELECT k FROM c
refuse.window_select: SELECT row_number() OVER () FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.aggregate_select: SELECT count(*) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.function_select: SELECT abs(a.k) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.constant_select: SELECT 1 FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.big_constant_select: SELECT 9007199254740993 FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.star_exclude: SELECT * EXCLUDE (k) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.star_replace: SELECT * REPLACE (a.k + 1 AS k) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.columns_star: SELECT COLUMNS('k.*') FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.schema_qualified: SELECT * FROM main.a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.catalog_qualified: SELECT * FROM memory.main.a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k
refuse.table_function: SELECT * FROM range(3) r JOIN a ON r.range = a.k
refuse.values_list: SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1)) v(k) JOIN a ON v.k = a.k
refuse.join_chain: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k JOIN c ON b.k = c.k
refuse.nested_join: SELECT * FROM a JOIN (b JOIN c ON b.k = c.k) ON a.k = b.k
refuse.table_column_alias: SELECT * FROM a AS x(k1) JOIN b ON x.k1 = b.k
refuse.multiple_statements: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k; SELECT 2
refuse.reserved_prefix: SELECT * FROM __qv_x JOIN b ON __qv_x.k = b.k
refuse.reserved_alias: SELECT * FROM a __qv_l JOIN b ON __qv_l.k = b.k
refuse.prepared_parameter: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k AND a.k = $1
refuse.lateral: SELECT * FROM a, LATERAL (SELECT * FROM b WHERE b.k = a.k) l
refuse.pivot: PIVOT a ON k USING count(*)
